review: Answers are reviewed without arm names or tool traces. Automated review is not an independent human audit.

understand-prepared-defaults: Traces HTTP input through Runtime recall to the pure PreparedContext renderer with valid citations.
Distinguishes omitted assembly from an explicit empty object, including Topic Memory and the six-Memory/two-Experience defaults.
Explains that an explicitly empty sections list produces empty context at this historical baseline.
Explains byte and entry budget enforcement using cited implementation evidence.
understand-source-processing: Traces Source observation admission and durable storage with citations.
Distinguishes accepted input from completed artifact processing.
Identifies the actual scheduling or supervisor path and selection of processing work.
Identifies durable progress/outcome or retry boundaries without claiming guaranteed immediate extraction.
understand-scope-authorization: Identifies the actual Scope access decision path and principal/resource boundary.
Explains snapshot or shared authorization decisions from implementation evidence.
Traces reference expansion into prepared-context candidate retrieval.
Explains exclusion of unreadable referenced Scopes without inventing cross-Scope access guarantees.
understand-memory-publication: Traces the Python Client request and HTTP handler into the Memory runtime service.
Explains durable publication or commit boundaries with valid citations.
Identifies text/vector index update behavior without equating a model call with a durable commit.
Distinguishes provenance and builtin service interfaces from backend implementation.
impact-cursor-signing: Identifies actual callers of cursor-secret resolution and signing consumers.
Connects the change to real public pagination paths with source evidence.
Names relevant regression tests with evidence; returns no more than 20 affected files/tests.
Separates proven static dependencies from possible downstream runtime consequences.
impact-http-transport: Identifies central insecure-HTTP validation and consent behavior.
Distinguishes shared Client behavior from copied or independently implemented plugin validation.
Names relevant transport/configuration tests with evidence; returns no more than 20 files/tests.
Avoids claiming all host integrations share one implementation merely because names match.
impact-scope-expansion: Identifies the implementation of cycle/depth handling and actual callers.
Traces affected Runtime retrieval operations with citations.
Names relevant Scope expansion and consumer tests; returns no more than 20 files/tests.
States unknown or negative cases and avoids unsupported impact inferred solely from symbol names.
impact-profile-resolution: Identifies effective Profile resolution and its direct consumers.
Traces automatic prepared-context consumers separately from persisted artifact reads.
Names relevant Profile and prepared-context regression tests; returns no more than 20 files/tests.
Distinguishes service/backend boundaries and static evidence from dynamic assumptions.
